question: Rukmini Devi Arundale was associated with which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer of the dance form **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She is credited with reviving and popularizing Bharatanatyam in its modern form, which was earlier known as **Sadhir**.
 
• Rukmini Devi founded the Kalakshetr
